'''Blazen''' was a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] who arrived too late to save an Imperial outpost. They were unable to stop [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] group [[Leary]] and [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Cathleen]]'' from stealing a group of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]].<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>
